༄༅/ /loka tri pā la'i las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i smad las kyi ngag 'don khrigs chags su phab pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /loka tri pā la'i las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i smad las kyi ngag 'don khrigs chags su phab pa bzhugs so//

yi dam gcud phur lha la phyag 'tshal lo// sde brgyad loka tri pā la'i gdab las kyi rim pa ni mchod rten dkar nag la brten pa'i bca' gzhi rgyas pa'i skabs sam| yang na brub khung gtor ma la brten pa'i bca' gzhi bsdus pa'i skabs sam/ skabs gzhan du 'byung bzhi dang*/ zlog bsad kyi 'khor lo re re khol bur dgos byung yang de dag legs par grub nas/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i gong du gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ loka tri'i ngag 'don grub rjes zhi bsnyen dang*/ rtsa bsnyen dang*/ srung sngags ci 'grub bzlas rjes gdab las bya/ de nas sgrub pa'i ring nangs re tho rangs skyabs sems rjes su ngag 'don byas rjes/ sngags gang bzla ba'i dmigs pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsgom zhing sngags la 'bad/ thun drug gam bzhir gdab las 'di bya ba yin no// gdab las dngos la bcu bdun te/ dpang gzu/ mkhyen gsol/ brub khung bskyed pa/ dgra bgegs 'gugs pa/ yi dam bskul ba/ che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa/ slar drag tu bskul zhing dgug pa/ lha dang dbye ba/ nyes pa bsgrags pa/ thun brab pa/ sngags bzla ba/ gnas spar ba/ phur bu gdab pa/ bsgral ba/ gtun du brdung ba/ zhal du bstab pa/ zlog pa bya ba/ las la sbyar ba rnams so// dang po dpang gzu dang mkhyen gsol ni/ gser skyems bshams la/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog rin chen gsum// lhag pa'i lha mchog drang srong dri ma med| |sprul pa'i khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje dang*// yi dam chos skyong srung ma mkhyen par gsol// snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad sprul 'khor bcas// rab 'jigs loka tri'i lha tshogs dpang mdzod cig /sngags 'chang bdag gis ma len ma nyes kyang*// dge bcu khyad gsod mi dge dang len pa'i// bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra dang bgegs// gzugs ling ming dang mtshan mar btab pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang dmod pa'i bden tshig gis// skad cig 'dir khug bsgral gdab las mdzod cig

/ces lan gsum gsol/ gnyis pa brub khung bskyed pa ni/ phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi brub khung lcags khang nag po gru gsum pa/ dug gi me 'bar ba/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ mtshon gyi char 'bebs pa'i nang du phag spyang gi thod par gshin rje pho mo 'jigs su rung ba gnyis kyi bar du dgra gdon byad ma che ge mo shin tu nyam thag pa/ mtha' skor du lha ma srin sde brgyad mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas rngams shing za bar gyur par bsam/ gsum pa dgra bgegs dgug pa ni/ dgug gzhug drag po nyer gcig bya zhing dmigs bya liṅga la drag tu bstim/ bzhi pa yi dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// zhes pa nas/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab// ces pa'i bar ngag 'don ltar bskul/ lnga pa che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ rang gi lce rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sde brgyad thams cad kyi snying nas drangs te/ mdun du 'khod pa'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram re bkab pas 'gul 'khyog mi shes par gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ */ nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab// ces pa nas/ nga yi las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs// zhes pa'i bar ngag 'don ltar bya/ slar yang lce rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sde brgyad kyi snying khar yod pa'i srog yig nas drangs pas 'dar zhing thal mo sbyar phyag 'tshal ci gsung bgyid do// zhes smra bar/ sa bon rnams drangs hūm̐ gi gdan du byas pas| sde brgyad thams cad kyis dgra bgegs 'gugs gsod sogs ci bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par gyur par bsam/ drug pa drag tu bskul zhing dgug pa ni/ bh+yoḥ mchod bstod bsnyen zhing bsgrubs pa'i ye shes lha// 'jig rten dregs byed yongs kyi srog snying bdag /thogs med phrin las sgrub pa'i drag rtsal can// rab 'jigs drang srong loka tri'i lha tshogs rnams| |bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// skyod cig skyod cig mnyam nyid dbyings nas skyod// skul lo skul lo thugs dam gnad nas skul// mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod// dregs 'dul drang srong chen po'i dus la bab// khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje'i dus la bab// sprul 'khor drang srong 'bum sde'i dus la bab// bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad dus la bab// do nub da dus nam gyi gung thun la// dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du bsdus la shog

/snang srid dregs pa'i srog snying phrog la shog /gnod byed byad ma dgra gdon khug la shog /drang srong chen po'i thugs rje byin ma chung*// dregs 'dul khro rgyal rdzu 'phrul rtsal ma zhan// bden tshig dmod pa'i drags sngags dbal ma rdugs// sprul 'khor sde brgyad las byed bang ma bul// dmigs par gang byas dgra gdon byad kha 'di// lo zlar ma 'gor myur du ma bsgral na// drang srong chen po'i bden tshig nyams par 'gyur// bka' nyan dregs pa'i mthu rtsal rdzun du che// de bas sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i tshogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la// yid la gnag pa'i dgra gdon gnod byed bgegs// gzugs ling ming dang byang bur btab pa 'di// lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung la shog /zhags pa can gyis ske nas khrid la shog /lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms la shog /dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs la shog /yi dam lha dang drang srong chen po yi// dmod pa'i bden stobs brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// che ge mo zhes gzugs ming liṅga la// myur du phob cig sarba nṛ tri dzaḥ */rings par khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ /myur du chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐// dam par sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ// drag por sgrol cig badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ /gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba nṛ tri aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes drag tu bskul lo// 'gugs pa ni/ rang gi lce rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i rwa rtse dgu la phog pas dzaḥdagu 'phros pa rta mig gi 'khor lo la phog /rta mig gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad dang rang gi lce rtse las spros pa'i dzaḥlas rang 'dra'i khro bo lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu thogs pa'i tshogs grangs med pa dang*/ bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa 'jig rten stong khams gang ba rnams kyis dgra bgegs dmigs bya de'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung*/

mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ rgyab nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis rdeg cing ded nas skad cig la bkug ste las khung drag po'i nang gi liṅga la sib sib thim pas dgra bgegs dngos su yod par gyur par dmigs la| oṃ loka tri pā la dzaḥ oṃ loka tri pā la dzaḥnas/ 'khor 'dul dzaḥzhes pa'i mjug tu/ yi dam lha dang drang srong gi bden pa chen po dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis myur du phob cig nṛ tri dzaḥzhes btags pa bzla'o// zhes sde brgyad kyi sngags mthar/ dzaḥdang de'i mthar/ sarba nṛ tri dgra bgegs che ge mo aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes sde brgyad re re kha sbyar ba gnad 'gag che ge mo btags pa bzla zhing*/ rta mig gi 'khor lo g.yab cing 'gugs bstim drag tu byas la khug rtags ma byung bar du ci mang bya ba gal che'o// bdun pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ khug pa'i rtags mtshan mthong nas sam/ lhas skyob pa'i rtags mthong na/ rang gi lce rdo rje'i rtse mo nas sprul pa'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa grangs med pa spros pas/ kho'i 'go ba'i lha srung rnams bya rog gi khyu rdos brdas pa ltar skad cig gis bskrad de/ kho skyob byed kyi lha dang phral zhing mgon skyabs med par byi'u phrug thang la bskyur ba ltar 'dug par gyur par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma 'di'i// srung skyob byed pa'i yi dam dang*// lhan skyes lha lnga 'go ba'i lha// byin rlabs dbang lha chos skyong dang*| |bsnyen sgrub mchod brten srung ma'i tshogs// ye shes 'jig rten lha tshogs rnams// drang srong bden pas da phrol cig /nṛ tri sarba de wa uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ a traka rak+sha mā ra ya shag phye/ nṛ traka rak+sha mā ra ya phye/ zhes brjod cing*/ do gal che na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar lha dbye'i rdzas dud kyang bya'o// brgyad pa kho'i nyes pa bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dug lnga'i dbang gyur dgra gdon khyod// rang nyes las ngan rang la smin| |da lta bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur// sngon gyi nyes byas la 'gyod cing*// phyis nas mi bgyi dam bca' nas// byang chub thob par khyod smon zhig

/ces bsgrags/ dgu pa thun zor brab pa ni/ thun rnams drag po sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ dmag dpung nad mtshon gnam lcags thog ser drag po thogs pa rnams dgra bgegs de'i steng du phab nas/ kho'i snying khar rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo mar me lta bu zhig yod pa de nag mnyag tu btang*/ lus ngag yid gsum thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag cing kho'i gzugs phung bem po de'i sha khrag rus pa lhag ma med par zos par gyur par bsam/ bh+yoḥ nga ni zhe sdang rdo rje ste// nga ni drang srong dri ma med// drang srong bden pa'i dmod tshig ni// lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa rnams// thun zor pho nyar bdag bskul gyi// stong gsum thun gyi pho nyas khengs// mtshe nyungs mtshon rdo zangs lcags phye// dug khrag drag po'i thun rdzas rnams// so so'i pho nyas mtshon cha thogs// nad mtshon thog ser than ltas ngan// ma rungs phyogs kun dgra bgegs steng*// kha char bu yug ltar phob la// dgra bgegs lus ngag yid tshe bsod// mi nor yul zhing longs spyod rnams// skad cig nyid la brlag par gyis// oṃ loka tri pā la nan rbad thuṃ 'jig rten mgon pos dgra bgegs che ge mo'i nṛ tri srog chod snying phyung mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad sod/ de bzhin du/ dgra bgegs nas/ bh+yo rbad sod kyi bar sde brgyad kar sbyar la/ sa ga pa sha nan rbad ling sa bdag gi= nā ga du du nan rbad phaṭa klu bdud kyi= ma maṃ ma maṃ rbad myog ma mo'i= tsir tsar tsir tsar rbad rbud btsan gyi= baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu rbad thuṃ bdud kyi= rbad tra ko sha ya/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad gza' bdud kyi= drag sngags 'di'i ser rnams bzhag nas nag po rnams bzlas na spu gri'i sngags zhes bya la ser dang nag po rnams lhan cig tu byas na thun sngags ring mo zer spu gri'i drag sngags ring mo'ang zer ro// ho ra ho ra/

rbad shag rgyal 'gong gi= rgyal po'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ bsen mo'i= pe har gyi= gtsang thel gyi= gnod byed che ge mo'i srog la= a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sde brgyad kyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ tsi du sod/ tsi du rbad thib shog lhu ru gtub rbad myog ha la pa ti nan/ ga ṇa pa ti rbad rmug |'khor ba dul rbad chom/ dgra bo che ge mo'i kā wā tsi brlag brlag rbad hur/ dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad nan/ gnod byed rgyal po thams cad rā tsa hab le hab le sod/ klu thams cad nā ga ling nā ga ling sod/ 'byung po thams cad ku tri ku tri sod/ bgegs thams cad 'gugs se 'gugs se sod/ gza' thams cad the tse the tse sod/ the'u rang thams cad rā tri rā tri mā ra ya sod/ bsen mo thams cad ru tri ru tri mā ra ya sod/ gre bo gre mo thams cad suṃ tri suṃ tri mā ra ya sod/ gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya sod sod/ rbad rbad/ dza dzaḥ zhes thun brab bo// de'i mthar nyi zla thal rdeb ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje gsal ba'i phyag tha ma gnyis rdo rje'i brag ri lta bur gyur pa'i thal mo gnyis nyi zla/ sor mo bcu gnam lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa/ thal mo brdabs pas/ nyi zla'i bar du dgra bgegs gnod byed dmar chal chal btang ba'i sha khrag dum bur thor thor song ba sdig pa rnams kyis lcib lcib zos par gyur par bsam zhing*/ thal mo rdeb bzhin pas bshad ma thag pa'i thun sngags ring mo'i 'og nas 'byung ba'i zlog bsad kyi sngags lan bdun re bzlas pa'i rjes su drang srong gi dmod pa ni/ bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa thams cad 'di ru ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /srid pa rtse nas shigs shig /srid gsum rming nas sgyel zhig /'khor ba gting nas phyung zhig /bskal pa'i mes sregs shig /dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shig /bka' yi chad pa chod cig

/gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig /suṃ bha nis non zhig /srid gsum gar skyes gar gnas kyang sdig can 'di'i steng du rdo rje'i me char chen po phob cig /gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad thul cig /bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis// thal byed rlung gis gtor ba ltar// gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur// drang srong dmod de bzlog tu med// zhes thal mo brdab/ de ltar sngags bdun bdun la dmod pa tshar re sbyar ba lan gsum bya'o// 'di yan chad bcas rgyas bsdus gang rung byas sam/ 'byung bzhi'i bsad zlog gi 'khor lo thams cad gang rung re re gnyis re sogs gang bcas kyang thun drug kar tshar re bya dgos so// de'ang thun drug la gtor mar sha zan sgron/ sman raka bran/ dgug gzhug gsum byas rjes/ gtor bsngos dang bstod bskul gang rung gi mthar mkhyen gsol nas thal rdeb kyi bar bya ba yin no// bcu pa sngags bzla ba ni/ srung ba dang rang bzhin zlog pa la ni/ bca' gzhi dang liṅga 'khor lo mi dgos pas sngags dmigs kyang 'dir ma bris la/ zlog bsad sogs la ni/ thun drug gi 'go rnams su mkhyen gsol nas thal rdeb kyi bar bya dgos shing*/ de'ang khug rtags ma byung gi bar/ rta mig gi 'gugs sngags brgya phrag sogs ci mang bzla/ khug rtags byung na 'gugs sngags grangs cung zad nyung bar bya'o// zlog pa drag po'i dmigs pa dang sngags ni/ rang gis zlog sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ lce gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa rnam par gdengs pa'i rwa rtse rnams su phaṭa me 'bar ba'i 'od zer mgar gyi tsha tsha lta bur phyogs thams cad du spros pas/ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa hrag hrag tshigs shing phaṭa dang zlog pas byad ma kho rang gi gshed du bab te kho'i sha zos/ khrag 'thung*/ rus pa mur/ thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bsam/ oṃ loka tri pā la nan bh+yo zlog nas/

ho ra ho ra bh+yo zlog /tsi du sod tsi du sod/ shig lhu ru gtub/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba dul/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kā wā tsi brlag brlag |dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bh+yo zlog /ces bzla'o// bsad pa'i dmigs pa dang sngags ni/ zlog dmigs kyi brlag par gyur gyi sham du/ phag spyang gi thod par gshin rje pho mor gsal ba'i zhe sdang dang 'dod chags kyi dug gis kho'i rtsa rgyud thams cad rul zhing myag /byad ma'i snying nang du nṛ tri'i khong par phaṭa dmar nag 'od du zhu bas dhīḥlas gnam lcags bsregs pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa phyi'i mu khyud med pa la rno gcod kyi ngar dang ldan pa zhig g.yon du drag la myur bar 'khor bas/ dgra bgegs de'i srog rtsa mya la la bcad cing sha khrag dum bur thor thor nyil nyil btang bas sde brgyad rnams kyis hab di ri ri zos par gyur par bsams pas/ zlog sngags kyi bh+yo zlog gi mal du sod ces bsgyur ba'o// 'byung bzhi'i dmigs sngags ni/ rang gis sngags bzlas pa'i tshe gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las 'od zer yar 'phros pa las/ rdo rje'i rwa'i rtse mo rnams su phaṭa dmar nag dgu las/ yaṃ ljang gu/ raṃ dmar po/ baṃ nag po/ nan ser po rnams dgu re 'phros pa bcas nang gi 'byung ba'i 'khor lo so so'i 'byung ba gzugs ris rnams dang rtsibs brgyad la phog pas/ 'khor lo de dag 'byung ba de nyid dngos su gyur pas stong gsum gang nas dgra bgegs gang yin de nyid rlung gis gtor/ mes bsregs/ chus khyer/ sas mnan/ thal ba'i rdul tsam yang med par gyur par bsam/ khyad par mnan pa'i skabs/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i phyag tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab bteg nas kho mnan pas lus ngag yid gsum mnan cing 'ching ba'i las byed par gyur par bsam/ zlog sngags kyi bh+yo zlog gi mal du rlung la yaṃ/

me la raṃ/ chu la baṃ/ sa la nan/ zhes btags la bzla'o// bca' gzhi rgyas bsdus gang yin yang 'khor lo thams cad rdzogs par yod na thog mar zlog pa drag po bya/ bzlog rtags mthong nas bsad pa drag po bya/ bsad rtags rdzogs nas 'byung bzhi'i sngags dmigs pa so sor dril nas rtags ma rdzogs bar du g.yel ba med par sgrub pa gal che'o// zlog bsad 'byung bzhi gang la'ang skabs skabs su las khung gi 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsibs so so'i sde brgyad rang rang gi sngags la sde brgyad so so bkug la bstims pas sngags de rnams sde brgyad dngos su gyur nas dgra bgegs de la sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar/ rub rub 'dus nas dgra bgegs de nyid bsad zlog gtor sreg sbyang mnan gang yin gyi las thams cad thogs med du byas shing*/ sde brgyad rang rang gi sngags yod pa'i rtsar sde brgyad rang rang gi gnas dang pho brang btab nas kho brlag pa'i las byas par gyur par bsam pa yang yang bya ba ni shin tu gal che ste/ gzhung las/ sde brgyad bkug la 'khor lo bstim// zhes pa'i don ni/ 'dir las thams cad kyi spro bsdu lce'i rdo rje nyid las bya ba ni/ gzhung las/ gcod pa lce la shes par bya// zhes pa'i don yin no// yang sde brgyad spyi'am dgos kyis gnod na de dag gi 'khor lo so sor rang gzugs can bris nas las sbyor bya ba dang*/ sngags kyi spel tshig kyang dgra bgegs kyi mal du sde brgyad gang gnod de nyid kyi ming sbyar zhing gzhan phal cher dkyus 'di nyid ltar byas pas grub pa yin pas 'phrul shes par byos shig /bcu gcig pa gnas spar pa ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pas zlog bsad 'byung bzhi thams cad re re gnyis re sogs gang sgrub kyi bsgrubs rtags brtan po mthong nas 'khor lo dang liṅga rnams bcas nang nas tshur phyung la lcags snod du bcer nas/ sngar gyi mkhyen gsol nas thal rdeb kyi bar tshar gcig byas rjes gyer sgom rtse gcig tu dril bas 'di skad ces/

e ma khams gsum sems can rnams// ma rtogs 'khrul ba snying re rje// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// thugs rje'i thabs kyi sbyor ba yis// phung po bsgral ba'i zhing du byas// rnam shes yum gyi mkha' la sba// ye shes dpa' bor byin brlabs te// rig pa chos kyi dbyings su 'phang*// khyod nyid rgyal ba'i sras su skye// zhes brjod/ slar gdab phur liṅga'i nṛ'am tri mig tu sgril zhing btab la/ hūm̐ */ ye shes rtsal ldan phur bu 'di// dgra bgegs snying la btab pa yis// nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad nas chod// las ngan rnam smin 'phro bcad nas| |ye shes dbyings su gnas spar ro// hūm̐ */ dgra gdon khyod kyi snying nang na// lus srog rnam shes chags pa'i rten// rlung dwangs sngo skya mthe bong tsam// de nang rak+ta'i dwangs ma ni// dmar ser rgya sran ga'u tsam// de dbus rnam shes ngo bo ni// thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam// de la ye shes phur bu yi// rno dbal gzi 'od reg tsam gyis// rlung gi dwangs ma 'ja' ltar yal| |rak+ta'i dwangs ma 'ubs kyis bskams// rnam shes ngo bo thig le de// ye shes phur bu'i khong gseng du// byang chub rgyun lam nang du zhugs// 'chang bzung logs brgyad pho brang du// dpal chen yab yum thugs ka ru/ skad cig nyid la thim ma thag /de lus sol sdong gog po bzhin// nag khog gzi bkrag med par gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ e yaṃ raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ bo dhi tsit+ta nṛ tri saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes 'don sgom zung 'jug la dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bya'o// bcu gnyis pa phur bu gdab pa ni/ gdab phur de nyid lag tu sgril zhing*/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje phur bu kī la ya// sangs rgyas phrin las yongs rdzogs sku// dregs 'dul drang srong khro chen gyi// sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya// sgril zhing sgril zhing btab tsam gyis// dgra bgegs lus ngag yid gsum dang*// phung khams skye mched 'byung ba lnga// las nyon bag chags shes sgrib bcas// skad cig nyid la bsgral nas kyang*// thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par mdzod// oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dzaḥ

badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dgra bgegs sarba nṛ tri sha trūṃ trig nan rbad nan bhi na tsit+ta rbad nan nṛ tri hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces dang*/ thun sngags spu gri drag sngags ring mo yang bzla zhing liṅga rnams kyi gnas lnga dang*/ dbang po lnga dang*| bla gnas sa rnams su dbal nub tsam du gdab bo// bcu gsum pa bsgral ba ni/ mi bsad pa'i mtshon cha thogs te/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku// 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang*// pad+ma rgya gram rab 'bar bas// ye shes rno ba'i mtshon cha yis// dgra gdon bag chags 'khrul ba'i sems// log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun chod cig /oṃ man+t+ra suṃ bha ni badz+ra dz+wa la hūm̐/ oṃ bh+rūṃ/ hūm̐ bh+rūṃ/ trāṃ bh+rūṃ/ hrīḥbh+rūṃ/ āḥbh+rūṃ/ tshal pa tshal pa mā ra ya dza dzaḥ zhes mtshon chas bsnun pa'i tshe phur bu'i dbal nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char bab pas kho'i gzugs phung rnams dum bur btang bar bsam/ rlung chu sa zlog bsad kyi liṅga rnams bsgral ba'i tshul tsam ma gtogs dngos su dum bur mi bsgral/ me'i 'khor lo dum bur btang la bsgral lo// bcu bzhi pa gtun du brdung ba ni/ ling ro rnams gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa drag sngags kyis ngar btags pas brdung zhing*/ gtun khung yum gyi bha gar tho ba yab kyi rdo rjes brdungs pas kho'i rnam smin gyi lus dmar nyog nyog brdungs nas brlag par bsam/ hūm̐ */ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di// rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral nas kyang*// khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdung ba na// lha yang rung ste brlag bgyid na// dgra gdon gnod byed smos ci dgos// oṃ pad+ma ā ko ṭa ya kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ/ zhes brdung ngo*// bco lnga pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ rgyas par na zan ling sha khrag rus pas sbags pa zhig gong du 'khor lo liṅga rnams dang lhan cig tu bsgral ba'i ling ro sha khrag rus par bcas pa gtor mar bstabs la/

bsdu na 'khor lo rnams gtor mar 'bul tshul tsam byas kyang rung*/ sman raka bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings gnas nas snying rje yi// rtsal snang khro bo'i skur bstan pa| |khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje yi// mthing nag mi sdug khro tshul can// khams gsum srid gsum za byed pa// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// ri rab tsam gyi sku bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags skyongs la// dgra gdon bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga| |don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas// zhal tu bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li// dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bh+yoḥ dregs 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba yi// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// sprul pa yang sprul la sogs pa// las byed rno myur rdzu 'phrul can// bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs bcas rnams// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// ri rab tsam gyi sku bzhengs shig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags skyongs la// dgra gdon bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga// don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas// zhal tu bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li// dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bh+yoḥ khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje yi// yang g.yog bka' nyan las byed ni// mgon po sa bdag klu rigs lnga// ma mo btsan bdud gza' rgyal 'gong*// snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpung bcas// rang rang sprul pa yang sprul dang*// g.yog dang yang g.yog pho nyar bcas// stong gsum gang ba'i dregs pa rnams| |khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// ri rab tsam gyi sku bzhengs shig

/gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i ljags skyongs la// dgra gdon bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// phung khams skye mched dbang po lnga// don snod klad rkang khu bar bcas// zhal tu bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li| |dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// zhes dbul zhing bstabs pas dgra gdon byad ma'i sha khrag rnams khro rgyal dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas hab hab hub hub chems chems gsol bas dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug stong ldir ba ltar mdzad nas tshim zhing dgyes par bsam/ dmod pa'i bden stobs brjod pa ni/ bka' ltar mi byed cing sogs nas/ bzlog tu med kyi bar sngar ltar thal rdeb kyi skabs ltar bya/ gzhan yang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo// skabs 'dir mnga' gsol thugs rje'i zlos gar yang bya'o// bcu drug pa bzlog bsgyur bya ba ni/ de ltar lha tshogs rnams rab tu dgyes pas zlog sgyur gyi las rnams thogs med du mdzad par bsams la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dregs 'dul drang srong dri ma med// de sprul rdzus skyes khro chen ni// 'jigs byed zhe sdang rdo rje dang*// khro rgyal de yi sprul pa dang*// yang sprul dam can rgya mtshor bcas// bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// rang rang g.yog sprul pho nyar bcas// 'khor dang bcas pa khyod rnams la// zlog sgyur phrin las bcol ba ni// sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams// do cig deng sang phan chad nas// sang phod da tsam tshun chod kyi// lo zla zhag dus spar sme dang*// srog lus dbang sme dgra gshed skag /gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa ngan// sa bdag phyogs ngan la sogs pa// mi mthun 'gal rkyen bzlog tu gsol// lha bdud ma mo rgyal btsan sogs// sde brgyad 'khrugs shing g.yos pa yis// 'go nad yams rims 'brum bu dang*// rgyu gzer gag lhog gnyen nad sogs// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog

/lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal bsen sogs// gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad dang*// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu zlog /snga zhag mda' ltar 'phen pa zlog /phyi zhag dug ltar 'thung ba zlog /lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub zlog /lha ma yin gyi sgyu thabs zlog /skem byed lcags kyus zin pa zlog /drang srong bram ze'i dmod pa zlog /mgon po'i par bu bskor ba zlog /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor bcas pa zlog /phur bu'i dbal kha 'phen pa zlog /phra men nye sbyor gtong ba zlog /pho nya'i rbod gtong rkang mgyogs zlog |ban+de'i 'bum skor byung ba zlog /bon po'i zor dmar 'phang ba zlog /mu stegs ngan sngags btang ba zlog /yungs kyi thun zor 'phang ba zlog /sngags pas sngags zor 'phang ba zlog |byad phur rbod gtong byung ba zlog /mnan gtad khram la gtad pa zlog /sreg 'phang las sbyor grub pa zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /pha mes rgan sri langs pa zlog /ma sru'i rgan sri langs pa zlog /byis pa'i chung sri langs pa zlog /dpon slob dam sri langs pa zlog /pra dang mo rtsis ngan pa zlog /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog |ma nyes kha yog ngan pa zlog /kha mchu kha smras ngan pa zlog /dug mtshon bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /btsa' sad ser ba lo nyes zlog /mi nad phyugs nad ngan pa zlog /thog 'khyug gnam lcags lce 'bab zlog /smyo 'bog brgyal nad ngan pa zlog /sa klu mdze phol shu 'bras zlog /gza' nad hur thum gtong ba zlog /snga dgra lag gis bdar ba zlog /phyi dgra yid la bzhag pa zlog |da dgra mdun du sdod pa zlog /lu+us kyi na tsha ngan pa zlog /sems kyi sdug bsngal ngan pa zlog /bsam don mi 'grub bar gcod zlog /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zlog

/zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog /sgyur ro drang srong dmod pas sgyur// gzir ro dgra dang bgegs la gzir// chos so gnod byed bgegs la chos// pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur// mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur// spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur// chung bdud dal kha thad du sgyur// rab 'jigs loka tri'i lha tshogs rnams// dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// bskul lo rbad do mthu ma chung*// drang srong bden pa'i bka' ma bcag /sngags 'chang dam tshig chud ma gsan// drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ zlog sngags bzla/ dmod mo bya zhing thal mo brdab/ zlog byang 'di las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i skabs thun drug tu thun brab zin pa'i rjes su tshar re byas na legs so// bcu bdun pa las la sbyor ba ni/ me'i 'khor lo mer bsreg liṅga'i gtor ma brgya rtsa saugs gzhung ltar/ rlung gi 'khor lo ri brag rlung sgra can la sba'am dum bur gtubs la rlung chen po la bskur/ liṅga 'jug snod sogs gzhung ltar byas/ chu dang sa dang zlog bsad kyi 'khor lo nas so sor gzhung ltar las la sbyar/ de'i rjes sgrub khang thog tu gser skyems btang*/ spro na bu lod kyi ljags bsgrigs phrin las zor gyi rim pa dang*/ drag po zor gyi gleng gzhi ltar zor rnams kyang gzhung sgrub kyi bca' gzhi dang lhan cig tu bcas nas gzhung sgrub kyi ring zor rnams kyang rang gzhung ltar zhar la bsgrubs zin pa byas pa'i zor rnams yod na thebs thog gam dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ slar nang du 'ongs la bskul pa gang yang rung ba dang bcas drag gtor de nyid khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje sprul pa yang sprul bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung stong khams gang ba/ go cha sra zhing mtshon rnon sna tshogs thogs pa mgo brnyan dang bzhon pa sna tshogs can/

'jig rten stong khams gang ba rnams kyis nad mtshon thog ser than dang ltas ngan sa chu me rlung gnam lcags drag po'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig la ki sgra bso sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sbir zhing dgra yul du song nas/ dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzugs phung yul mkhar thams cad bcom ste thal ba'i rdul du brlags/ rjes shul tsam yang med par las kyi rlung gis phyag par bsams la thebs thog gam dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ bris sku dang phyar dar ral pa brdab/ brang brdung*/ cho nges gdab/ zlog bsad kyi sngags dang dmod pa bor zhing thal mo brdab/ slar sa la chos 'byung sa bon dang bcas pa bris pa'i steng du me bus la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim dmod pa byas la gtor snod chus bshal bas me bsad/ mnan sngags dang sa mā dhi byas shing rta bro brdung*/ rgyas gdab/ gtor gzhong sman 'brus bkang ba nang du khyer/ nang du slebs pa dang bsrung ba'i bzlas sgom dang tshe sgrub bya'o// tshul 'di rnams ni pad+ma las kyi ngag 'don nyer mkho rnams bris pa yin gyi/ de dag gi bca' gzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis dang zlog bsad 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo dang sde brgyad so so'i 'khor lo bri ba sogs/ dgos pa skabs su bab pa'i lag len dmar khrid rnams ni 'di nyid rang gi gzhung gter kha gong 'og gnyis dang zhal gdams 'gro mgon spom brag pas bla ma seng sgom la gnang ba dang*/ de'i yig chung srung zlog bsad gsum gyi zhal gdams dang*/ de rnams su mi gsal ba rnams rgyal dbang rat+na'i mtshan can la bu lod rin chen bzang pos zhus pa'i zhal gdams gnad kyi zin bris go bstun nas lag len ma 'chug par bya ba gal che'o// zhes pa'ang loka tri'i gzhung dang phrin las sogs dang*/ rje rat+nas mdzad pa'i ngag 'don dang*/ bu lod rin bzang gis mdzad pa'i gdab las sogs 'don cha rnams phyogs gcig tu smad las kyi

༄༅/ /rim pa gang dgos rnams tshang bar bsgrigs pa 'di ni/ me yos hor zla gnyis par 'di nyid kyi las sbyor sgrub pa zhig bgyis pa'i thun bar du/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa ngag 'don bsgrigs pa ma gtogs rang bzo'i rtsam chos tshig gcig kyang med do// 'di pho brang bkra shis tshugs su bsdad pa'i dus nye bar 'brum pa'i 'tshe ba dang*/ byad gtad kyi ngo zhig byung ba'i tshe las sbyor sgrub pa zhig bgyis pas nad bdag tshar bcad cing*/ phyis kyang rang nyid la 'brum pa'i 'tshe ba mi 'byung zhes lha'i zhal mthong gsung thos pa'i tshe yid ches skyes te phyi rabs la phan pa'i blos bkod pa yin no/// /maṅga laṃ//
